commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' 3 - 0 Goal! Marcos Llorente tees up Koke (Atl. Madrid) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the middle of the goal. 3:0.
90+3' Juan Martinez Munuera blows the whistle, Yangel Herrera (Girona) is penalised for a foul.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Portu (Girona) heads on.
88' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
87' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
87' The attendance is 60414.
87' Koke (Atl. Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
86' Koke (Atl. Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

86' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
85' Bryan Gil (Girona) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
82' It looks like Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) saw red with that tackle. Juan Martinez Munuera won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
81' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Antoine Griezmann and he is replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
81' Substitution. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Julian Alvarez walks off.
79' Bryan Gil (Girona) takes a long-range shot, but his attempt is not a big threat to the goalkeeper.
78' Girona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
77' A cooling break is underway.
76' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle after Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
74' 0:8 – the corner kicks stats.
72' Bryan Gil (Girona) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
71' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
71' Iker Almena (Girona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play and Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
69' Bojan Miovski (Girona) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Jan Oblak pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
68' Here is a change. Samuel Lino is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid).

68' A rebound falls kindly for Miguel Gutierrez (Girona), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Viktor Tsygankov will be replaced by Iker Almena (Girona).
68' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Bojan Miovski (Girona) inside the box.
67' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
67' Yangel Herrera (Girona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. Girona win a corner kick.
66' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find Marcos Llorente, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
65' Bryan Gil (Girona) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
63' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
61' 8:7 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
59' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Rodrigo de Paul will be replaced by Koke (Atl. Madrid).
59' Michel prepares a substitution. Oriol Romeu is replaced by Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
59' Bojan Miovski (Girona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Abel Ruiz.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ivan Martin leaves the pitch and Portu (Girona) comes on.
58' The manager makes a subsitution with Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) coming on for Rodrigo Riquelme.
58' Yangel Herrera (Girona) jumps into a tackle and Juan Martinez Munuera signals a foul.
56' The foul by Oriol Romeu (Girona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Juan Martinez Munuera.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
52' The resulting corner from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is cleared.
52' The ball is cleared after Bryan Gil (Girona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Girona get a corner.
48' 2 - 0 Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) fires the ball from mid-range and it goes into the top of the net. What a hit! Pure magic.
47' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
47' Abel Ruiz (Girona) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
46' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle after Yangel Herrera (Girona) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' A pass by Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
45+3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bryan Gil (Girona).
45+3' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
45+2' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Girona force their opponents to concede a corner.

45+1' Abel Ruiz (Girona) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Jan Oblak anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
42' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) strikes a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with an excellent save.
41' Girona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
41' Abel Ruiz (Girona) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Jan Oblak pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. It will be a corner kick for Girona.
39' 1 - 0 Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a low shot that ends inside the left hand post. The goalkeeper stood there helpless.
39' A free kick on the edge of the box for Atl. Madrid. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
37' Yellow card! It's like Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Juan Martinez Munuera agrees and books him.
36' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
32' The referee blows for a cooling break.
32' A clumsy foul by Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle.

31' Daley Blind (Girona) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the left side of the target, but Jan Oblak keeps the ball out.
31' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
30' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

30' Oriol Romeu (Girona) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Good work from Girona as they win a corner.
28' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Abel Ruiz (Girona) receives a yellow card!
28' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Martinez Munuera who sees an offensive foul.
25' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) sees a yellow card from Juan Martinez Munuera after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
24' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
22' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) sends a long ball in, but Paulo Gazzaniga comfortably gathers the ball.
20' The corner from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is cleared away by the defence.

20' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Juan Martinez Munuera signals.

19' What an amazing save by Paulo Gazzaniga! Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot low towards the middle of the target, but fails.
18' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
17' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
14' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
11' The ball possession at the moment is 34:66.
10' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) is flagged for offside.
9' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is penalised for holding. Juan Martinez Munuera signals a set piece.
8' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Oriol Romeu (Girona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

6' What a wasted opportunity by Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
4' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
4' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. Girona win a free kick.

2' Good play from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) gives him some space for the shot from distance, but it's lacking accuracy and goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
